text: The presence of those needle-shaped inclusions, known as Auer rods, is pathognomonic for Acute Myeloid Leukemia. Do you experience any difficulty breathing or shortness of breath, which could indicate anemia-related hypoxia or lung involvement? REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy
